Activity details
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: The region has a caller-supplied real heading and all scrollable content remains native text/list/link. The visual scrollbar is aria-hidden; it is not a second fake adjustable widget. Overflow must not be the only indication that more content exists.
updatesAndDescendants: Root is role=presentation and wraps an internally created Viewport, vertical ScrollBar and Corner. Scrollbar/Corner are aria-hidden. Viewport is tabindex=0 only while at least one axis overflows, otherwise -1. Native scrolling drives viewport position, edge and thumb geometry. Root props are not Viewport props; the wrapper exports no Viewport and does not promise forwarding onScroll or aria-label to it. External sizing must make the viewport constrained. ScrollBar orientation defaults vertical; horizontal is explicitly composed. It does not auto-follow messages or preserve chat anchors; MessageScroller owns that behavior.
referenceDecision: This reference uses an outer labelled section because the wrapper Root remains presentational. Native keyboard/wheel/touch scrolling and focusable descendants remain available. Browser scroll position is internal viewport state, not an invented Root value/onValueChange API.
keyboard: Root is role=presentation and wraps an internally created Viewport, vertical ScrollBar and Corner. Scrollbar/Corner are aria-hidden. Viewport is tabindex=0 only while at least one axis overflows, otherwise -1. Native scrolling drives viewport position, edge and thumb geometry. Root props are not Viewport props; the wrapper exports no Viewport and does not promise forwarding onScroll or aria-label to it. External sizing must make the viewport constrained. ScrollBar orientation defaults vertical; horizontal is explicitly composed. It does not auto-follow messages or preserve chat anchors; MessageScroller owns that behavior.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
protocol: Source-normalized observations project real internal image/scroll state, derived progress, caller-owned upload props or the composed Collapsible protocol. No generic activation callback is invented. Internal lifecycle observations are not public Root events.

root.description: Presentational source Root; constrained by chosen height, not a fake adjustable value.

viewport.description: Actual private viewport, tabindex follows measured overflow; Root props are not forwarded here.

scrollbar.description: Actual aria-hidden draggable source scrollbar; orientation vertical or horizontal.

thumb.description: Actual private Thumb, dimensions/translation remain source-measured.

content.description: Chosen content padding/flow, not an exported Viewport API.
